description: Election Commission - A. J. W. Wickramasiri was Selected as the member of the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the nomination and declaration of a selected member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
